@dailyWirdTitle.description: Title of the Daily Wird screen: the user's daily program of worship acts (adhkar, Quran reading, duas). 'Zad' = provision for the day and night.

@dailyWirdReminderSleepLabel.description: Label of the bedtime adhkar reminder switch in Daily Wird settings.

@dailyWirdProgramHeader.description: Section header in Daily Wird settings above the list of ready-made programs (presets).

@dailyWirdSaveSetup.description: Button that saves the Daily Wird settings (reminders + chosen program).

dailyWirdItemNotFound: تعذر العثور على عنصر الزاد التعبدي.

@dailyWirdTodayTasksHeader.description: Section header above today's list of worship acts in Daily Wird.

dailyWirdStreakDays: {count, plural, =0{المداومة 0 يوم} =1{المداومة يوم واحد} =2{المداومة يومان} few{المداومة {count} أيام} many{المداومة {count} يومًا} other{المداومة {count} يوم}}

@dailyWirdStreakDays.description: Streak: number of consecutive days the user kept up the daily program.

@dailyWirdWeeklyAdherence.description: Percentage of the daily program completed over the last week.

dailyWirdChoosePresetSubtitle: ابدأ ببرنامج جاهز ثم خصّصه كما يناسبك

@dailyWirdItemOptions.description: Tooltip of the overflow menu on one worship act in the Daily Wird list.

@dailyWirdEditTargetCount.description: Menu item / sheet title: change how many times a counted dhikr should be repeated.

@dailyWirdStartOver.description: Reset the progress of one worship act to zero.

@dailyWirdCountHint.description: Hint in the number field for the target repeat count. Use the target language's digits/wording, e.g. 'e.g. 50 times'.

@dailyWirdTimeMorning.description: Short time-of-day tags shown next to a worship act (morning / evening / night / any time).

@dailyWirdTimeMorningLong.description: Longer time-of-day labels on the single worship act screen (morning time / evening time / before sleep / any time).

@dailyWirdTypeDhikrSet.description: Type tags of a worship act: set of adhkar / counted dhikr / Quran portion / dua (supplication) / surah.

@dailyWirdCountProgress.description: Progress on a counted dhikr button, e.g. '12 of 33'.

@dailyWirdCompletedOf.description: Counter on the single worship act screen, e.g. 'You completed 12 of 33 times'. {unit} is an optional unit from the content data (Arabic), already prefixed with a space, or empty.

@dailyWirdItemDone.description: State label of a worship act that has been completed today.

@dailyWirdMarkComplete.description: Short button: mark a worship act as done.

@dailyWirdCountOnce.description: Button that adds one repetition to a counted dhikr.

dailyWirdReminderMorningBody: ابدأ نهارك بذكر الله وتلاوة كتابه والدعاء.
dailyWirdReminderEveningBody: جدد صلتك بالله، وأتم ما تيسر من زاد المساء.
dailyWirdReminderNightBody: اختم يومك بالذكر والدعاء وما بقي من زادك التعبدي.
dailyWirdReminderSummaryBody: راجع زادك التعبدي اليوم، وانظر ما أتممت منه.

@dailyWirdReminderMorningTitle.description: Daily Wird notification titles/bodies (morning, evening, before sleep, end-of-day self-review). The summary title is also the label of its reminder switch.

@wirdMorningAdhkar.description: Names of the morning / evening adhkar collections (remembrances of Allah said after Fajr and after Asr).

@wirdPagerPosition.description: Position in single-dhikr view, e.g. 'Dhikr 3 of 24'.

@wirdShowSingle.description: Tooltips of the view-mode toggle: show one dhikr at a time / show all as a list.

@wirdRemaining.description: Repetitions left for a dhikr, e.g. '2 left of 3'.

@wirdCompleted.description: Shown when the user finished all repetitions of a dhikr.

@wirdVirtue.description: Heading: the virtue/reward of saying this dhikr (fadl).

@wirdReadOnce.description: Counter button: 'I read it once' — decreases the remaining repetitions by one.

wirdPlayAllFinished: تم الانتهاء من تشغيل جميع الأذكار.

@wirdNowPlaying.description: Label above the dhikr currently being recited in audio playback.

@wirdRepeatProgress.description: Audio playback: which repetition of the current dhikr is playing, e.g. 'Repeat 2 of 3'.

thikrMorningSubtitle: وردك بعد الفجر إلى ارتفاع النهار
thikrSleepSubtitle: ما تقوله قبل النوم وعند الفزع منه
thikrPrayerJumuahSubtitle: أذكار الأذان ودبر الصلاة ويوم الجمعة

@thikrGroupDuas.description: Group header: supplications transmitted from the Quran and Sunnah.

thikrQuranicDuasSubtitle: دعاء الأنبياء كما جاء في كتاب الله
thikrFuneralSubtitle: ما يُقال في الصلاة على الميت وعند القبر
thikrTasbeehSubtitle: عدّاد يحصي تسبيحك ويحفظ حصيلة يومك
thikrMyDuasSubtitle: أدعيتك التي أضفتها بنفسك في مكان واحد

@thikrSliderSubtitle.description: Subtitle on the highlighted card that opens the morning or evening adhkar depending on the current time.

@afterPrayerFallbackTitle.description: Fallback title of an after-prayer dhikr whose text is empty.

@afterPrayerRepeatCountLine.description: Line in the shared/copied text of a dhikr.

@afterPrayerVirtueLine.description: Line in the shared/copied text. {virtue} is Arabic religious text from the content data.

@afterPrayerMentioned.description: Value of the 'Virtue' badge: whether a virtue is stated for this dhikr (stated / not stated).

afterPrayerRepeatTimes: {count, plural, =1{مرة} =2{مرتان} few{{count} مرات} many{{count} مرة} other{{count} مرة}}

@afterPrayerRepeatTimes.description: How many times to repeat a dhikr, e.g. 'once', '3 times'.

@myDuasTitle.description: 'My duas': supplications the user wrote and added themselves.

myDuasEmptyCustomMessage: هذا القسم يعرض الأدعية التي أضفتها أنت فقط.
myDuasEmptyMessage: أضف دعاءك الأول وسيظهر هنا مباشرة.
myDuasAddSubtitle: اكتب الدعاء ليظهر ضمن أدعيتك الخاصة.
myDuasEditSubtitle: يمكنك تعديل النص أو الوصف وحفظ التغييرات مباشرة.

@myDuasTodayLabel.description: Total number of times the user repeated their duas today.

@ruqyahTitle.description: Ruqyah: Quranic verses and prophetic supplications recited for healing and protection.

@ruqyahDefaultReference.description: Source shown when a ruqyah item has no reference: 'The Holy Quran'.

@ruqyahRepeatLine.description: Repeat count of a ruqyah item. {count} comes from the content data (may be a word or a number).

@ruqyahReferenceLine.description: Line in the shared text. {reference} is the source (Arabic content).

@ruqyahDescriptionLine.description: Line in the shared text. {description} is Arabic content.

@ruqyahNumber.description: Ordinal label of a ruqyah item, e.g. 'Ruqyah 3'.

@radioTitle.description: Title of the Islamic radio screen (live Quran recitation stations).

@radioKindReciters.description: Station groups: Quran reciters / programs and recitations.

radioFavouritesHint: اضغط مطوّلًا على أي محطة لإضافتها إلى المفضّلة.

@radioAddedToFavourites.description: Snackbar after long-press. {station} is the station name (from the server, usually Arabic).

radioSleepTimerDescription: يتوقّف البثّ وحده بعد المدّة المختارة.
radioMinutes: {count, plural, =1{دقيقة واحدة} =2{دقيقتان} few{{count} دقائق} many{{count} دقيقة} other{{count} دقيقة}}

@radioMinutes.description: Sleep timer duration option in minutes.

@radioStopBroadcast.description: Stops the stream completely (different from pause).

@radioTuning.description: Status while the station stream is connecting/buffering ('tuning in…').
